typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ExtactFilePath as string (),
	ExtractToFile as string (),
	LO_REPORT_INFO as string (),
	LSQ_ARCH as string (),
	LSQ_DELETE as string (),
	LSQ_GETREPORT_DETAILS as string (),
	LS_FILE as string (),
	OLL_BATCHID as integer (),
	OLL_REPTID as integer (),
	OLL_SCHDID as integer (),
	OLS_ARCH as string (),
	OLS_OUTA as string (),
	OLS_OUTP as string (),
	OLS_Query1 as string (),
	OLS_Query2 as string (),
	OracleDataSource as string (),
	OraclePassword as string (),
	OracleProvider as string (),
	OracleUserID as string (),
	PDT_BATDATE as timestamp (),
	PDT_RUNDATE as timestamp (),
	PL_BATID as integer (),
	PL_REPTID as integer (),
	PL_SCHID as integer (),
	RLL_RecordCount as integer (),
	RunDate as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		REPT_ARCH as string,
		REPT_QUERY1 as string,
		REPT_QUERY2 as string,
		BATCH_ID as integer,
		REPT_OUTP as string,
		REPT_OUTA as string,
		SCHD_ID as integer,
		REPT_ID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT BAT.BATCH_ID, MAST.REPT_ID, BATDET.SCHD_ID , MAST.REPT_ARCH, OUTP.AMCTR_DESC REPT_OUTP, OUTA.AMCTR_DESC REPT_OUTA, MAST.REPT_QUERY1, MAST.REPT_QUERY2  FROM AGP.MSB_REPORT_BAT BAT INNER JOIN MSB_REPORT_BAT_DET BATDET ON BAT.BATCH_ID = BATDET.BATCH_ID AND BATDET.BAT_DET_STS = 1 and REPT_STS = \'A\' and SCHD_STS = \'A\' INNER JOIN AGP.MSB_REPORT_MASTER MAST ON MAST.REPT_ID = BATDET.REPT_ID INNER JOIN AGP.MSB_MCTR_LKUP OUTP ON OUTP.AMCTR_ENTITY =\'REMA\' and OUTP.AMCTR_TYPE =\'OUTP\' and OUTP.AMCTR_VALUE = MAST.REPT_OUTP INNER JOIN AGP.MSB_MCTR_LKUP OUTA ON OUTA.AMCTR_ENTITY =\'REMA\' and OUTA.AMCTR_TYPE =\'OUTA\' and OUTA.AMCTR_VALUE = MAST.REPT_OUTA WHERE BAT.BATCH_ID = 0 Order by BATDET.SCHD_PRIORITY',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		REPT_ARCH as string,
		REPT_QUERY1 as string,
		REPT_QUERY2 as string,
		BATCH_ID as integer,
		REPT_OUTP as string,
		REPT_OUTA as string,
		SCHD_ID as integer,
		REPT_ID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		REPT_ARCH,
		REPT_QUERY1,
		REPT_QUERY2,
		BATCH_ID,
		REPT_OUTP,
		REPT_OUTA,
		SCHD_ID,
		REPT_ID)) ~> OutputPlaceHolderReportRecordSet
